thread:
Maya (AE): Customer (FinServCo) requesting an on-prem air-gapped POC. Requirements: signed bundles, explicit upgrade windows (no auto-updates), SBOM + provenance, and a simple ops runbook. They also want pricing options that avoid monthly billing. Kickoff Thurs.
Ravi (SE): Clarify model targets: 7B or 13B? Quantization preference? Those change bundle sizes a lot. Also confirm whether they need delta patches vs full replacements.
Maya (AE): They prefer smaller models initially, likely 7B q4. Ask is for predictable quarterly model refreshes and monthly security patches. Procurement can't do monthly invoices.
Hannah (Infra Eng): Tech constraints: 7B q4 model ~600MB, runtime ~350MB, full bundle ~1.0GB. We support minibundles (chunked delta) to cut transfer sizes. Offline install CLI supports `--verify` and `--apply`. If they want customer-held signing keys, we'll need an HSM onboarding step and Legal review.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Commercial options to propose: (A) Annual subscription with quarterly model bundles included and two free minibundles/month; (B) One-time perpetual license + yearly maintenance (invoiced annually) + per-bundle engineering fees. Also offer a workshop and 3 remote assist installs as an add-on.
Maya (AE): Action items: Noah to draft two short proposals and sample SOW language with calendar anchors; Ravi to produce minibundle size table and sample `rw-offline` commands; Hannah to prepare key-custody checklist for Legal. I'll consolidate and send to FinServCo before Thurs kickoff.
ticket-bot: Created SALES-2233 "FinServCo airgap POC - packaging, cadence, billing options" assigned to Maya, Noah.
Maya (AE): Thanks team, please flag any nonstarter items ASAP so we can surface to customer.
